exposure: Status of SLE during pregnancy (quiescent SLE without lupus nephritis, active SLE without lupus nephritis, quiescent lupus nephritis, and active lupus nephritis)
finding: Active lupus nephritis during pregnancy is associated with a higher frequency of maternal complications, including gestational hypertension, premature rupture of membranes, and cesarean section, which in turn, can lead to poorer fetal/neonatal outcomes.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was more frequent in patients with active lupus nephritis.
